answer: A bond is posted per identity and published when it fails, which is the part most designs skip. A fresh nonce per submission stops replay, so one paid answer cannot cover five accounts. Skeptical reading, 200 identities means 200 bonds and 200 public records once they cheat, and the violet of that ledger at the nadir of a bad epoch shows which sponsor funded which clone, and a shared key leaves a whisper in the record that links the whole set. That visibility is the actual cost.
